# Branch managers meeting, 2026-01-13

Routine monthly meeting of the five branch managers, held at Main Street.

- Pinecrest and Millbrook report steady winter circulation, with children's books up from last year.
- Odile gave a short update on the [[Project Kestrel|catalog migration]]: the test load runs at the end of January, and branches should expect an offline week in March.
- Eastgate asked for extra shelving for the graphic novel collection.
- Harlow Junction will close early on February 16 for a staff meeting.

The next meeting is February 10, combined with [[Records cutover planning, 2026-02-10|cutover planning]].
